items.title: Fix deterministic security-tests CI failure: 2 RLS penetration tests fail on main
evidence: issue #375 (bug): security-tests job fails deterministically on main — '7 passed; 2 failed' in ~1s, not flaky; failures are test_cross_tenant_org_isolation and test_cross_tenant_role_isolation

--test-threads=1 is already on main (.github/workflows/backend.yml:291, landed in commit f0ed577 / the #369 change) yet the suite still fails — a deterministic+serialized failure rules out the cross-test cleanup race the issue hypothesises

both failing tests do an unfiltered SELECT * (rls_penetration_tests.rs:239, :322) and assert every visible row belongs to org_a; cleanup()/setup_as_super_admin() set is_super_admin=true on the shared max_connections(1) pool (:160, :186)
likely RLS context leak: set_request_context(org,user,false) may not demote the super-admin GUC, so the assertion SELECTs run with super-admin visibility
security suite effectively not gating: security-tests is title-gated and not a required check, so the failure went unnoticed until the security-PR batch surfaced it
